headline: Frontline Volatility Shifts to Godcrofts and Palantine Berm Amid Raging Clashes
war_summary: Since our last report, the rapid turnover in Linn of Mercy has halted completely with no base exchanges recorded over the past two hours, while Weathered Expanse slowed to two transfers despite four strategic points remaining ruined no-man's-land. The primary tempest has instead shifted toward Godcrofts and Palantine Berm, which logged eleven and ten base actions respectively during the watch. Godcrofts saw violent reversals across Fleecewatch, Isawa, and Ursa Base, whereas Palantine Berm remains locked in an accelerating brawl over Vendett and Windburn Landing. Further east, Stlican Shelf re-erupted into the war's fiercest bloodbath, tallying five base transactions and over nineteen hundred casualties in two hours as Breaker Town churned. Marban Hollow likewise registered six fresh exchanges across Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall amid rising losses. The previous slaughter in Nevish Line has sharply subsided, yet heavy casualty spikes have newly erupted across Farranac Coast—where Transient Valley remains contested—and Callahan's Passage.
